g.text: Distribution of input and output tokens per request — Azure LLM inference traces, 2024

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: What it shows: how input and output token counts are distributed across 44,107,694 observed Azure inference requests. Left

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: panel counts requests per token bin; right panel gives the cumulative share, so any percentile reads off the curve.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Source: Microsoft Azure, AzurePublicDataset — LLM inference production traces (2024 release, CC-BY) —

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280
font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Methodology: §3.2 — What we measured; §7.9 — De-duplication rule 3, sub-types

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: Observation window — conversation 12 May 2024 – 18 May 2024; code 10 May 2024 – 16 May 2024. Computed from all 44.1 million requests

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: in the release, streamed in chunks - nothing is sampled or estimated. Note the two services cover different weeks, overlapping by

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: five days, so they are not a matched pair; they are separate workloads and must not be pooled. One week of one provider's production

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: traffic is not a market-wide sample. The horizontal axis is log-scaled because token counts span several orders of magnitude and a

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: linear axis would collapse everything below a thousand tokens into a single bar; bins are left-closed powers of two. No request is

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: excluded and the full long tail is drawn.
